role: The item frame hanging entity: holds one item stack and a rotation on a wall, drops them when broken.
scope_reason: Item frames are not switched off in world.conf (only maps, which the frame's map-dot removal touches, are).

members.name: itemDropChance
members.note: always 1.0F in play: only a command's NBT sets another; the chance draw is spent and the NBT writes 1.0F

members.name: EntityItemFrame
members.note: no spawn path uses the bare ctor natively

members.name: EntityItemFrame
members.note: tile x/y/z and direction; fh_set_direction does the EntityHanging setDirection arithmetic

members.name: entityInit
members.note: DataWatcher indexes 2 and 3; the native engine keeps item/item_damage/rot in fh_ent

members.name: attackEntityFrom
members.note: a frame showing an item only drops it (the drop-chance draw, the copy at offset 0) and empties, keeping the rotation; an empty one breaks through EntityHanging's body. Reached from the player's hit, arrows and throwables, and falling anvils; details-frames-s1

members.name: getWidthPixels
members.note: the 9-pixel width is hardcoded in the frame branch of the box arithmetic

members.name: onBroken
members.note: EntityHanging.onBroken, the Entity parameter always null on the native paths

members.name: func_146065_b
members.note: drops the frame, then the displayed item against the drop chance draw

members.name: removeFrameFromMap
members.note: map-dot removal; world.conf maps = off so filled maps never draw

members.name: getDisplayedItem
members.note: fh_ent.item/item_damage/item_tag, written back in the Item NBT and on the drop

members.name: setDisplayedItem
members.note: the insert (a copy of size 1, rotation kept), the hit's clear, the dev op and the NBT restore; the ItemStack's own tag is not carried (fh_ent holds id and damage)

members.name: setItemRotation
members.note: (rot + 1) % 4 on each right click of a full frame; details-frames-s1 turns one three times

members.name: writeEntityToNBT
members.note: Item, ItemRotation and the hanging base tags

members.name: readEntityFromNBT
members.note: the snapshot restore path reads the displayed item and rotation

members.name: interactFirst
members.note: the server half through pickobj_server_interact (processUseEntity's reach), the client's true answer through pickobj_client_interact; details-frames-s1

notes: Verified fh_spawn_frame, fh_set_direction (the hardcoded 9-pixel frame box), on_broken and the NBT pair in csrc/engine/fallhang.c. persist-hanging-s1 covers placement and whole-server persistence of an item frame (DEVLOG lane/persist2). The removeFrameFromMap map-dot removal is out of scope while maps are off; I did not verify any attack-on-frame recording. lane/idxentity: the frame's DataWatcher reads are its struct fields. lane/villagetrade 2026-09-27: the tail-only evidence (X-01/X-02) now points at the full re-records persist-hanging-full-s1, whose native replay starts before the behaviour.
